title: Potency Test: Glucose Stimulated Insulin Release Assay
author: Integrated Islet Distribution Program
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.buzhnx36

steps.title: Prepare PIM(R) Complete Media
steps.instruction: Prepare a bottle of PIM(R) complete media by adding supplements to PIM(R) media.

substeps.instruction: Thaw and add 5 mL of PIM(G).
Add 25 mL of (heat inactivated) Gemini AB serum (5% v/v).
Add 0.5 mL of sterile ciprofloxacin aliquot.
Note: Media expires within 30 days once supplemented.

steps.title: Isolate and Culture Islets
steps.instruction: Isolate islets and maintain them in an incubator.

substeps.instruction: Remove at least 400 IEQ from the purest layer using sterile technique (Calculation: Total IEQ / (Total mL * 1000 μL) = x IEQ/μL; then 400 IEQ / x IEQ/μL = y μL).
Place islets in a 100 mm Petri dish with 15 mL PIM(R) Complete, label, and cover.
Incubate the dish at 37°C in 5% CO2.

steps.title: Prepare Krebs Buffer Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 L of Krebs Buffer Stock Solution.

substeps.instruction: Combine in a 1 L volumetric flask: 5.96 g HEPES powder (25 mM), 6.72 g NaCl (115 mM), 2.02 g NaHCO3 (24 mM), 0.3728 g KCl (5 mM), 0.2033 g MgCl2•6 H2O (1 mM), and 1.0 g BSA (0.1%).
QS to 1 L with distilled water and mix until dissolved.
Add 0.3675 g CaCl2•2 H2O (2.5 mM) and stir.
Adjust pH to 7.3 - 7.5 using 1 N NaOH or 1 N HCl.
Filter sterilize using a 0.22 μm bottle top filter into a sterile 1 L bottle.
Divide into 18 x 50-ml aliquots in sterile tubes.
Store at 2°C – 8°C (expires 4 weeks after preparation).

steps.title: Prepare Glucose Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare stock and working concentrations of glucose solutions using Krebs Buffer Stock Solution.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 280 mM Glucose stock: Add 3.0 g D-(+)-Glucose to 60 mL Krebs Buffer Stock Solution, filter sterilize (0.22 μm), divide into 10 x 6-ml aliquots, and store at 2°C – 8°C (expires 4 weeks).
Prepare High Glucose (28 mM) Solution: Perform a 1:10 dilution of 280 mM Glucose stock using Krebs Buffer Stock Solution. Store at 2°C – 8°C (expires 1 week).
Prepare Low Glucose (2.8 mM) Solution: Perform a 1:10 dilution of 28 mM High Glucose Solution using Krebs Buffer Stock Solution. Store at 2°C – 8°C (expires 1 week).

steps.title: Set Up 24-Well Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the 24-well plate with glucose solutions and inserts.

substeps.instruction: Label a 24-well plate with sample ID and date.
Add 1.0 mL 2.8 mM Low Glucose Solution to wells A1, A2, A3.
Add 1.3 mL 2.8 mM Low Glucose Solution to wells B1, B2, B3.
Add 1.3 mL 28 mM High Glucose Solution to wells C1, C2, C3.
Place one Millicell Cell Culture Plate Insert into wells A1, A2, and A3 using forceps.
Cover and incubate at 37°C in 5% CO2 for 1 hour to equilibrate pH and temperature.
Transfer 1.0 mL of each glucose solution into marked tubes (High Glucose Control and Low Glucose Control) and store at 4°C – 8°C.

steps.title: Prepare Islet Suspension
steps.instruction: Prepare the islet suspension for plating.

substeps.instruction: Remove the Petri dish from the incubator.
Collect islets by centering tissue and removing them in 100 µL PIM(R) complete media using a wide bore micropipette.
Transfer islets to a 5 mL conical tube and add 1400 µL PIM(R) complete media.

steps.title: Plate Islets and Equilibrate
steps.instruction: Transfer islets to the plate and equilibrate them in basal media.

substeps.instruction: Place inserts in empty wells D1, D2, D3.
Slowly pipette 300 µL of well-mixed islet suspension into each insert in row D.
Drain liquid from inserts on sterile gauze and transfer inserts to wells A1, A2, A3.
Replace lid and incubate for 1 hour at 37°C in 5% CO2.

steps.title: Low Glucose Stimulation Phase
steps.instruction: Transfer islets to low glucose media and collect samples.

substeps.instruction: Transfer inserts from row A to row B (B1, B2, B3) by lifting gently with forceps, wicking liquid from the mesh against the well side, blotting the bottom on sterile gauze, and setting into the well.

Collect Zero Time Low Glucose samples: Allow liquid to equilibrate, lift insert to drain liquid back into the well (do not blot), remove 300 µL of media from the well, transfer to tubes labeled 'Zero time – Low Glucose', and immediately replace the insert.
Incubate the plate for 1 hour at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Remove inserts from row B and transfer to row C (as described in the A to B transfer).
Collect all media from row B wells into tubes labeled 'Low Glucose' and store at 4°C – 8°C.

steps.title: High Glucose Stimulation Phase
steps.instruction: Transfer islets to high glucose media and collect samples.

substeps.instruction: Collect Zero Time High Glucose samples from row C using the same method as the Low Glucose Zero Time samples, transferring media to tubes labeled 'Zero time - High Glucose'.
Incubate the plate for 1 hour at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Remove inserts from row C and transfer to row D (as described in the A to B transfer).
Collect all media from row C wells into tubes labeled 'High Glucose' and store at 4°C – 8°C.

steps.title: Prepare ELISA Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary solutions and controls for the insulin ELISA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Wash Solution: Mix 800 mL distilled water and 40 mL Concentrate Wash Solution in a 1 L bottle; store at 2°C – 8°C (expires 4 weeks).
Prepare Conjugate Solution: Mix 100 µL Conjugate Stock Solution with 1 mL Conjugate Buffer per microstrip; store at 2°C – 8°C (expires 1 day).
Reconstitute Controls: Allow Diabetes Ag Control vials to reach room temperature for 5 minutes. Add 500 µL distilled water to each vial, let sit for 5 minutes, and swirl gently.
Aliquot Controls: Aliquot 95 µL of 'Low Control' and 95 µL of 'High Control' into separate 1-ml microcentrifuge tubes; store at < -20°C (expires 3 months).

steps.title: Perform Insulin ELISA
steps.instruction: Measure insulin concentration in the collected supernatants.

substeps.instruction: Dilute supernatants using DPBS (commonly 1:50 or 1:100) to target a detected range of 31.8 to 191 mU/l.
Bring all reagents and samples to room temperature.
Pipette 25 µL of calibrators, controls, and samples (in triplicate) directly onto the bottom of microplate wells.
Add 100 µL Enzyme Conjugate to each well.
Incubate on a plate shaker at 800 rpm for 1 hour at 18°C – 25°C.
Wash the plate 6 times: fill each well with 350 µL Wash Buffer, invert and shake to discard, and finally tap firmly against absorbent paper.
Add 200 µL TMB Substrate Solution to each well.
Cover with aluminum foil and incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature (18°C – 25°C).
Add 50 µL Stop Solution to each well and shake for 5 seconds.
Read optical density at 450 nm (reference 600 – 690 nm) within 30 minutes.

steps.title: Calculate Stimulation Index
steps.instruction: Calculate the Stimulation Index (SI) from the ELISA results.

substeps.instruction: Calculate SI = (Insulin concentration after high glucose stimulation) / (Insulin concentration after low glucose stimulation).
Average results from the three samples.
